swiftness.name: Verse of Swiftness
swiftness.text: +15 evade, +1 move. In a clash: +3 agility.

freeClimb.text: A Sage (Layra) hops from one high spot to another: her moves ignore height, and she flies over anyone in her way.

stone.name: Verse of Stone
stone.effectNote: Suleiman 30 Oct: the effect of the Verse of Stone is called Earth's Bulwark. Its short word is EARTH because BULWARK is already the Warden's signature.
stone.text: Earth's Bulwark, +2 defense. In a clash: +3 guard, harder to push.

stillGuard.text: A spearman (Gaha) who doesn't move on his turn plants his feet: half damage, and nothing can push him, until his next turn.

spiritBoltFire.name: Ember Bolt
spiritBoltFire.text: Kofi reads Fire: his Spirit Bolt sets the target alight, 2 damage a turn for 3 turns (never the last point; Herbs put it out).

spiritBoltWater.name: Tide Bolt
spiritBoltWater.text: Kofi reads Water: his Spirit Bolt leaves the target Drenched for 2 turns, so lightning hurts it more.

spiritBoltEarth.name: Stone Bolt
spiritBoltEarth.text: Kofi reads Earth: his Spirit Bolt knocks the target a tile back (into a wall, it slams).

spiritBoltStorm.name: Gale Bolt
spiritBoltStorm.text: Kofi reads Storm: his Spirit Bolt jumps to a second enemy within 2 tiles for half damage.

haunt.name: Haunt

resist.note: 13.60: the chance to land, in percent: 60 plus 8 for each point of Kofi's magic attack over the target's magic defense, kept between 25 and 95 (92 against a fighter, 68 against Layra).

haunt.text: A hex: the spirits leave the target Disoriented for its next 2 turns (attack -2, defense -2, evade -10, magic hits it harder; Herbs lift it). It rolls against the target's magic defense first: a strong mind can shake it off. What Kofi reads adds to it when it lands. Fire: it also burns. Water: Drenched. Earth: bound, slower for 3 turns. Storm: shaken, its aim or trance breaks and it is Off-Balance.

infuse.name: Infuse
infuse.text: A blessing for an ally within 3 tiles, or himself, from what Kofi reads. Earth: the Stone Verse. Storm: Swiftness. Fire: Fury. Water: Renewal, a healing that starts at once and goes on for 3 turns. Ready again after 2 turns.

renewal.name: Renewal
renewal.text: Kofi's Water blessing (only through Infuse, roadmap 1.49, 6.38). It heals as soon as it is given, and again at the start of each of its turns: each time about 5% of its health (at least 3 points) and one weak status lifted (poison, burn, blinded or disoriented). Lasts 3 turns.

slow.name: Slow
slow.text: Its next turn comes later, and it is slower for 2 turns.

husk.name: Husk
husk.text: Leave a decoy that fools the enemy and slip up to 3 tiles away, even out of a clash. Enemies chase the decoy. If nobody strikes it by your next turn, it echoes your next spell: a second bolt of Lightning, or a Verse or Slow twice as strong. Cast under Swiftness, a struck decoy bursts in a howling gust: enemies next to it are blown 2 tiles away.

meditate.name: Meditate
meditate.text: Sink into a trance: your next turn is spent meditating too (you can't act), then 6 MP come back. You are Exposed until then, so keep allies close.

spearThrow.name: Spear Throw
spearThrow.text: Hurl the spear at an enemy up to 3 tiles away, 1 tile further for each level you stand above it. A hit knocks it back a tile (off a ledge, it falls; into a wall, it slams and is Disoriented). A higher block in the way stops the throw. Ready again after 3 turns.

lunge.name: Lunge
lunge.note: Gaha's Spearman Build (Suleiman, 15 Nov; roadmap 13.59). Numbers are the PDF's defaults. Advance up to 2 tiles in a straight line, then Thrust: +1 damage for each tile he advanced. He stops where his spear (reach 2) just touches the foe, so the foe stands 2 to 4 tiles away in a line (at 2 he does not run: +0). The run does not use up his Move. Not in a clash. Cancels Rooted that turn.
lunge.text: Run up to 2 tiles in a straight line at an enemy, then Thrust: 1 extra damage for each tile you ran. The foe must stand 2 to 4 tiles away in a straight line. The run does not use up your Move. Not during a clash. It moves you, so you are not Rooted this turn. Ready again after 3 turns.

herbs.name: Herbs
herbs.text: Throw a pouch of healing herbs to an ally up to 2 tiles away (one tile further for each level you stand above them), or use it yourself: +10 health, and it cures poison and puts out a burn. Ready again after 3 turns. Only 3 pouches a battle.

poisonArrow.name: Poison Arrow
poisonArrow.text: Take aim this turn; the arrow flies at the start of your next turn if the target is still within reach and in clear sight (a higher block in the way stops it). Half damage, then 3 damage at the start of each of its next 3 turns. Poison never takes the last point of health, and Herbs cures it. Ready again after 3 turns.

intercept.name: Intercept
intercept.text: Charge up to 4 tiles at an enemy and slam it with the shield: half damage, and it's locked in a clash with you. If it was clashing with an ally, you take over and the ally is free. Ready again after 3 turns.

shieldToss.name: Shield Toss
shieldToss.note: 19.5 (Bull Commander rebalanced, v2): the Stun comes only on a target that was already Off-Balance before the toss (Horn Charge on a Guarding foe sets that up); otherwise damage only. It never makes Off-Balance itself. Before Batch 7 it stunned every target.
shieldToss.text: Hurl the shield at an enemy up to 3 tiles away (a higher block in the way stops it): half damage. A target that was already Off-Balance is also Stunned for a turn (it loses its next turn, can't dodge, takes flank hits +3). Ready again after 3 turns.

doubleHit.name: Double Hit
doubleHit.text: Strike with both heads of the spear: two quick hits on an enemy next to you, each 60% of a normal hit, each rolled on its own. When Rabdul attacks, there is a 35% chance he strikes this way.

shieldRam.name: Shield Ram
shieldRam.text: Stone turns Intercept into this: charge up to 4 tiles and ram the enemy 2 tiles back, no clash. Into a wall, it slams and is Disoriented. 3 Verse MP.

furyCharge.name: Furious Charge
furyCharge.text: Fury turns Intercept into this: charge up to 4 tiles and hit with your full strength, no clash. 3 Verse MP.

blitz.name: Blitz
blitz.text: Swiftness turns Intercept into this: a charge too fast to answer. Half damage, and it is stunned for a turn, no clash. 3 Verse MP.

sonicJavelin.name: Sonic Javelin
sonicJavelin.text: Swiftness turns Spear Throw into this. Up close: dash in and whirl the spear down. Further (5 tiles): a throw that hits every enemy in its line, through high blocks. At a reeling foe: zip to it and sweep low (1.5x damage). Never misses. 3 Verse MP.

furyDive.name: Fury Dive
furyDive.text: Fury turns Spear Throw into this: leap up to 3 tiles, over heads and walls, and slam down on an enemy for 1.5x a normal blow. Enemies next to where he lands are knocked Off-Balance. Never misses. 3 Verse MP.

thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
thunderclap.text: Stone turns her Lightning into this: the bolt knocks the target a tile back (into a wall, it slams). It still jumps to a second enemy.

healingWind.name: Healing Wind
healingWind.note: Roadmap 10.50 (Suleiman 21 Nov): a new heal Layra casts under Swift, in place of Lightning, that costs a lot of MP. Numbers picked 21 Nov: 12 health to the ally (or herself) within 4 tiles, 6 to each ally next to them, 6 MP (half her 12; a Verse costs 3). Not a 'verse' move on purpose: Lightning comes back on her Attack button when nobody in reach is hurt or her MP is under 6.
healingWind.text: Under Swift, in place of Lightning: a wind that heals an ally within 4 tiles (or herself) for 12, and every ally next to them for 6. It also cures poison and puts out a burn. 6 MP. Lightning comes back when nobody in reach is hurt or her MP is short.

wildfire.name: Wildfire
wildfire.text: Fury turns her Lightning to fire: it sets the target alight, 2 damage a turn for 3 turns (never the last point; Herbs put it out). Fire doesn't jump.

enchant.name: Enchant
enchant.note: Roadmap 4.1 (Suleiman OK'd): Shango's symbol set on a weapon. Rabdul has 9 MP, so three casts a battle.
enchant.text: Rabdul calls on Shango and sets his symbol on a weapon: his own, or an ally's up to 3 tiles away. For its next 3 turns that weapon burns: +2 damage on every hit (+1 against a Drenched target, the water dulls the flames). Costs 3 MP. Ready again after 3 turns.

earthDrive.name: Earth Drive
earthDrive.note: Roadmap 4.2 (proposal built as proposed): half damage, push 1, the spike lasts 2 of Tayo's turns.
earthDrive.text: Tayo drives his fist into the ground and a spike of rock bursts up under the foe in front of him: half damage, and it is thrown back a tile (into a wall or a unit: a slam). The spike stays as a wall for 2 of his turns: nobody walks through it and it stops arrows and thrown weapons. Ready again after 3 turns.

clap.name: Sonic Burst
clap.note: Roadmap 13.31 (Baiyee 8 Nov, Suleiman agreed, no more long range): an area around Tayo, not a line. Every foe within 2 tiles takes a little damage (30 percent of a hit) and is knocked back 1 tile with the usual push rules (a wall or a unit behind it: a slam). The AI claps when 2 or more foes are within 2 tiles. Drawn with his attack pictures until Suleiman sends his Sonic Burst art (ART10). Renamed from Sonic Clap on 13 Nov (roadmap 13.37); the id stays "clap".
clap.text: Tayo claps his hands with all his might. A shockwave blasts every foe within 2 tiles: a little damage, and each is knocked back a tile (into a wall or a unit: a slam). Combo: any Earth Drive rock of his within 2 tiles bursts, and each foe next to a burst rock takes 4 more. Ready again after 3 turns.

elementBlast.name: Element Blast
elementBlast.note: Roadmap 13.4 (Suleiman's 6 Nov art, 13.17): only while an element is on him. Enchanted = fire (sets Burn, burn and turns as Wildfire), Drenched = water (leaves the target Drenched, puts out a burn). Spends the element. A straight line, range 3, full damage, a block in the way stops it like an arrow.
elementBlast.text: Tayo gathers the element on him into one fist and fires it down a straight line, up to 3 tiles (a higher block in the way stops it). Full damage. Enchanted: a fire blast that sets the target Burning. Drenched: a water blast that leaves the target Drenched. It spends the element (the Enchant ends, or he dries off), so it only works while one is on him. Ready again after 3 turns.

pinningShot.name: Pinning Shot
pinningShot.note: 19.6 (Archer kit sheet, 19 Nov): bow only, 2 to 5 tiles, normal sight and hit rules. Half a bow blow; on a hit the target is Pinned through its next turn (conditions.json pinned).
pinningShot.text: Bow only, 2 to 5 tiles. Half damage, and a hit Pins the target through its next turn: it cannot walk or use a skill that moves it (it can still attack, cast and fight in a clash; a push still moves it). Ready again after 3 turns.

primeBow.name: Prime Bow
primeBow.note: 1.82 (Suleiman 21 Nov: takes a turn to charge, hits harder, longer range). Numbers picked 21 Nov: +4 attack (about double her blow on most foes) and +2 reach on her next Attack with the bow.
primeBow.text: Draw the bow and hold it: this uses your turn. On your next turn your Attack with the bow has +4 attack and reaches 2 to 7 tiles. The draw is lost if you do not shoot that turn, or if you are caught in a clash. Tap again to draw. Ready again after 3 turns.

poisonWeapon.name: Poison Weapon
poisonWeapon.note: 1.82 (Suleiman 21 Nov: apply poison to her weapon at any point in time). A free action in her turn (even after acting, or in a clash); the next hit that lands poisons like Poison Arrow.
poisonWeapon.text: Free, at any time in your turn: coat your arrows and dagger. Your next hit that lands Poisons the target (3 damage at the start of each of its next 3 turns, never the last point). Ready again after 3 turns.

wardSwitch.name: Ward
wardSwitch.note: 13.68 (Suleiman 19 Nov: his ability to shield and take damage for others should be something you can turn on and off). The switch for Sudeen's Ward passive (jobs.json guardian passives.ward). Free, any time in his turn.
wardSwitch.text: Ward (passive): allies next to you get +1 defense (+2 under Stone) and you take a third of each hit on them (half under Stone), at most 4 (5), never below 1 health. Off in a clash, when Stunned or at 1 health. Tap to switch it on or off; it costs nothing.

interceptAlly.name: Intercept Ally
interceptAlly.note: 19.3 (Sudeen's kit sheet): Intercept's ally mode. Swap tiles with an ally within 4 walking steps (a clear path; its tile at most 1 level from his). If the ally is in a clash he takes it over and the ally is free. No damage.
interceptAlly.text: Swap places with an ally up to 4 steps away (a clear path, and its tile at most 1 level above or below yours). If the ally is in a clash, you take it over and they are free. No damage. Ready again after 2 turns.

spearWard.name: Spear Ward
spearWard.note: 19.4 (Rabdul's revised kit): overwatch until the start of his next turn. The 8 tiles round him are threatened; a foe that ENTERS one is struck (75 percent of a blow, normal roll); a hit stops its walk there (it may still act), a miss uses a charge too. 2 charges, one strike per foe per walk. He cannot move while it holds. Replaces Whirl (never built).
spearWard.text: Hold the spear out until your next turn: the 8 tiles round you are guarded. A foe that steps into one is struck for 75% of a blow; a hit stops it there. 2 strikes in all. You cannot move while it holds; using it replaces Hold the Line. Tap again to set it. Ready again after 3 turns.

holdLine.name: Hold the Line
holdLine.note: 19.4: brace until his next turn: +2 Guard in a clash (the sheet's value TBD, picked 21 Nov), no push or pull moves him, and once he contests a foe that walks onto a tile next to him (his hit chance against it; a win stops it there, no damage). He cannot move. Replaces Plant and Vault (never built). One stance at a time with Spear Ward.
holdLine.text: Brace until your next turn: +2 Guard in a clash, pushes and pulls do not move you, and the first foe that walks next to you is stopped there if you win the contest (your hit chance). You cannot move; using it replaces Spear Ward. Tap again to brace. Ready again after 3 turns.

haftSweep.name: Haft Sweep
haftSweep.note: 19.4: half a blow, Off-Balance and a push of 1 tile (a drop makes it further, as every push). Sets up an ally's Relay Strike.
haftSweep.text: Sweep the haft through a foe next to you: half damage, it is knocked Off-Balance and pushed 1 tile (down a drop it falls). Allies next to where it lands may Relay Strike. Ready again after 3 turns.

rapidWard.name: Rapid Ward
rapidWard.text: Swiftness turns Spear Ward into this: set the ward and still walk up to 2 tiles this turn (the ward goes with you). 2 strikes, 75% of a blow, a hit stops the foe. 3 Verse MP.

anchoredWard.name: Anchored Ward
anchoredWard.text: Stone turns Spear Ward into this: a strike that hits also pushes the foe 1 tile back. You are Rooted until your next turn (hits on you are softened, you cannot move). 3 Verse MP.

kindleHaft.name: Kindle the Haft
kindleHaft.text: Fury turns Enchant into this, on your own spear only: for 3 turns it burns (+2 damage a hit), and your first hit each turn sets the foe alight: 2 damage at the start of each of its next 3 turns. A Drenched foe does not catch fire (+1 instead). 3 MP.

kindleBurn.name: Kindled
kindleBurn.text: Set alight by Rabdul's Kindle the Haft: 2 damage at the start of each of its next 3 turns.

hornCharge.name: Horn Charge
hornCharge.note: 19.5 and 6.73: charge in a straight, clear line 2 to 3 tiles at the first foe in it (no passing through anyone, no step up of more than 1 level), no clash. 2 tiles: 75 percent of a blow; 3 tiles: a full blow. A hit pushes a foe 1 tile (further down a drop; into a wall: the slam, 2 damage and Disoriented), or leaves a Guarding foe (Guard in a clash, Rooted, Hold the Line) Off-Balance instead, never both. A miss does nothing. Pictures: art.json e2 poses.charge (plain, Bloodied, Enchant looks), fx horn_dust and horn_fire.
hornCharge.text: Charge 2 or 3 tiles in a straight, clear line into the first foe (no clash): 75% of a blow from 2 tiles, a full blow from 3. A hit pushes it 1 tile (into a wall it slams: 2 damage and Disoriented), or knocks a foe who is Guarding Off-Balance instead. Ready again after 3 turns.

ricochetToss.name: Ricochet Toss
ricochetToss.text: Swiftness turns Shield Toss into this: half damage to the target, then the shield bounces to another foe within 2 tiles of it for half damage too (each rolled on its own). Only the first can be Stunned, and only if it was already Off-Balance. 3 Verse MP.

wrathToss.name: Wrath Toss
wrathToss.text: Fury turns Shield Toss into this: a full blow, and a hit knocks the target Off-Balance (no Stun). 3 Verse MP.

quakeToss.name: Quake Toss
quakeToss.text: Stone turns Shield Toss into this: half damage, Stun if the target was already Off-Balance, and on a hit the other foes next to it are thrown 1 tile away (no Stun for them). 3 Verse MP.

smokeBomb.name: Smoke Bomb
smokeBomb.text: Throw a smoke bomb at your own feet. Enemies next to you are Blinded for 1 turn (their attacks mostly miss, and they cannot start a clash or take aim). Then slip up to 2 tiles away for free: you are Hidden for 1 turn, so enemies cannot target you. The cloud stays until your next turn. Ready again after 3 turns. Not during a clash.

reverseGrip.name: Reverse Grip
reverseGrip.text: Free, once a turn, no action: turn the sword-staff round. Fork leading: his attack (Fork Strike) also hits the next foe straight behind the target at half damage, and Snare Hook and Sunder Boon are ready. Blade leading: his attack (Blade Strike) does 2 more damage, and Heavy Cleave is ready.

snareHook.name: Snare Hook
snareHook.text: Fork end. Hook a foe up to 2 tiles away in a straight line: half damage, and it is pulled 1 tile toward him (into a unit or a wall: a slam). A pulled foe next to his allies can take Relay Strikes. Ready again after 3 turns.

sunderBoon.name: Sunder Boon
sunderBoon.text: Fork end. Tear one blessing off the foe next to him (Swiftness, Earth's Bulwark, Fury or an Enchanted weapon). No damage. Adds 2 to his Mask Gauge. Ready again after 3 turns.

heavyCleave.name: Heavy Cleave
heavyCleave.text: Blade end. A slow overhead strike at the foe next to him: one and a half times the damage, ignoring 2 of its defense. Ready again after 3 turns.

singularity.name: Singularity
singularity.text: Needs a full Mask Gauge (6). He dons the mask: it takes his whole turn, and the area within 3 tiles of him is marked. At the start of his next turn every foe within 3 tiles is pulled up to 3 tiles straight toward him; one stopped by a wall, a higher level or another unit takes 2 damage and is Disoriented, one that ends next to him is Off-Balance. Then every foe still standing takes a blow that cannot miss, 1.5 times a normal hit of his. Then he is Exposed for a turn (defense -2, evade -10) and the gauge is empty. A Stun, a fall or a slam on him while it charges breaks it. Once a battle.

verseSwap.name: Swap Verse
verseSwap.text: Free, once a turn, no action: his Echo Verse becomes Active and the Active one goes to the Echo. The incoming Verse Surges once: Swiftness a free step, Fury his next Press pushes the momentum one step further, Stone shakes off Off-Balance and cancels the next push this turn.

drawnBlade.name: Drawn Blade
drawnBlade.note: 10.49 (Suleiman 21 Nov): Drawn Slash can free an ally from a clash. A hit on a foe locked with one of his ends that clash; the ally is free and the foe is locked with Alagara.
drawnBlade.text: The sheathed draw: he feints, then cuts the foe next to him (full damage). A hit locks them in a clash with the momentum already one step his way, a free Press. If the foe was clashing with one of his allies, the ally is free and Alagara takes over. Ready again after 3 turns.

claim.name: Claim
claim.text: Take one blessing from the unit next to him, ally or foe (a Verse, an Enchanted weapon, or Bloodied stacks: those take a point off every hit on him): it leaves them and is his for 2 turns. A Verse goes in his Active slot (the old one to the Echo). Ready again after 3 turns.

mantle.name: Mantle
mantle.text: Share his Active Verse with every ally within 3 tiles at half strength, for their next turn. Needs an Active Verse. Ready again after 3 turns.

galeCut.name: Gale Cut
galeCut.note: 10.48 (Suleiman 21 Nov): a bit more base damage (0.8 of a blow became 1, a full blow) and the movement left adds damage like Gaha's Lunge: +1 for each step he has not used yet when he cuts (up to +4 with his Move of 4).
galeCut.text: In any form. He dashes in a straight line as far as his move, cutting through every foe on the way (each takes a full blow, rolled on its own, +1 for each step of movement he has left), and stops on the first free tile past the last one. Walk first and the cut is weaker. Uses his move. Ready again after 3 turns.

rendingDraw.name: Rending Draw
rendingDraw.note: 1.99 (Suleiman 22 Nov 02:09: "Rend should become a fully active skill for Alagara in all his forms"): no longer tied to Fury (it was full strength under an Active Fury and 75 percent from the Echo); full strength in every form and with no Verse.
rendingDraw.text: In any form. A Drawn Blade that ignores 2 of the foe's defense and throws it 2 tiles back (into a wall or a unit: a slam). Ready again after 3 turns.

bulwarkShield.name: Aegis
bulwarkShield.note: Roadmap 10.46 (Suleiman 21 Nov): the answer to area attacks like Gadara's Singularity. share = part of each fighter's own max health the shield soaks; turns = how many of that fighter's turns it lasts; range = allies within this many tiles. Suleiman's defaults: 20 percent, 2 turns, 2 tiles.
bulwarkShield.text: Earth's Bulwark. He raises a shield on himself and every ally within 2 tiles: it soaks damage (hits, slams and falls, Singularity too) up to 20 percent of each one's max health, for 2 turns. From the Echo: 15 percent, one more turn of cooldown. Ready again after 3 turns.

unmoved.name: Unmoved
unmoved.text: Stone, a reaction (no button): the first push or pull on him is cancelled, and he answers the one who pushed with a half-strength counter if they stand next to him. From the Echo: 75 percent, one more turn of cooldown. Ready again after 3 turns.
